talk.text: Hold on. Is that house sitting on a waterfall?
Right on top of it! The family wanted a view of their waterfall, and Frank Lloyd Wright gave them the waterfall itself.
(laughs) Okay, but why aren't those balconies falling into the stream?
They're cantilevers. Concrete trays, held at one end only, anchored back into the house.

label.name: The hatch
label.meta: Living room stairs down to the stream

talk.text: And that glass box in the living room?
That's a hatch. Slide it open, and stairs take you straight down to the water.

caption:
Is that house sitting on a waterfall? 🌊

Frank Lloyd Wright's Fallingwater (1939): the terraces are concrete cantilevers held at one end, and a glass hatch in the living room opens onto stairs down to the stream.
